import csv, json, hashlib, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
root, checker, output = sys.argv[1:]
runs = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    for name, expected_code, expected in [('consistent',0,{}),('conflicting',1,{'LAMP-FAMILY':['LAMP-100','LAMP-200']})]:
        source = Path(root) / 'fictional-inputs' / (name + '.csv')
        mapped = Path(td) / source.name
        with source.open(newline='', encoding='utf8') as src, mapped.open('w',newline='',encoding='utf8') as dest:
            writer = csv.writer(dest)
            writer.writerow(['expected_family','offer_id','item_group_id'])
            for row in csv.DictReader(src):
                writer.writerow([row['supplied_family_label'],row['id'],row['item_group_id']])
        cmd = [sys.executable, checker, str(mapped)]
        result = subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
        observed = json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout else None
        runs.append(dict(name=name,argv=cmd, original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), mapped_csv=mapped.read_text(), mapped_sha256=hashlib.sha256(mapped.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr, matches=result.returncode==expected_code and observed=={'conflicting_families':expected}))
report=dict(source=json.loads((Path(root)/'merchant-api-field-evidence.json').read_text()), checker_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(checker).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), mapping={'expected_family':'supplied_family_label','offer_id':'id','item_group_id':'item_group_id'}, runs=runs)
Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps([dict(name=r['name'],exit_code=r['exit_code'],stdout=r['stdout'],matches=r['matches']) for r in runs]))
